text: Adopt PROJECT-LOG.jsonl as the append-only development history for AutoTwin. This records product decisions and implementation evidence; it is separate from end-user chat history.

User-approved product direction: reconstruct an operation from operational data, simulate proposed changes, and compare outcomes. Agent/operator evaluation is one supported experiment, not the sole product objective. Start with user-directed what-if simulation; automatic optimization is deferred. Imported from the current conversation.

Accept operational data spanning multiple participants: event logs, linked business records, snapshots, schedules, procedures, and other evidence. Do not require one operator per upload or force all sources into one event-log schema. Discover the shared process and candidate roles before selecting an evaluation role. Imported from the current conversation.

A selected operator or team has bounded observations, authority, actions, and objectives. Other participants remain part of the shared operation. Observed assignments do not establish formal permissions. Process improvement may instead change staffing, capacity, rules, or automation. Imported from the current conversation.

Keep business process modeling, executable simulation, optimization, and digital-twin claims distinct. A historical-data model is not automatically a synchronized digital twin. Imported from the current conversation.

Step 1 is a provisional discovery behavior, tested for coverage and direction. Let domain knowledge propose important missing processes, dependencies, and alternative interpretations. Label hypotheses rather than restricting discovery to recorded columns or demanding proof before exploration. Imported from the current conversation.

Keep the product user-directed in the existing terminal. No startup pipeline. No user biography or learning preferences in runtime instructions. Keep source code small; no new dependencies, custom chat store, or unit-test suite for this skill revision.

Existing terminal launcher and read-only helpers are present. The previous skill is inspect-data. Native terminal state uses the local .dcode profile. Existing research notes describe source-code inspection of Data-driven BPS and Simod; those external applications were not executed. Bootstrap entry from inspected files, not a new runtime test.

Replace inspect-data with discover-operation. Align runtime instructions and README. Preserve method references. Validate the skill and run one bounded model check focused on process coverage and improvement framing.

Renamed inspect-data to discover-operation. Reframed discovery around shared processes, participant handovers, improvement objectives, and explicit hypotheses. Updated runtime instructions and source-method notes. No runtime Python or dependency changes.

Synthetic multi-role discovery smoke check completed with Luna: identified pick-pack-book handovers, proposed investigating waiting without more staff, and did not assume a worker was idle. This is a behavior check on synthetic input, not validation on real operations.

Fetched the previously identified mirrored SCMS dictionary. Saved its numbered field entries with source URL and source hash; excluded blank spreadsheet padding. Publisher provenance remains unverified.

User requested discovery on all four datasets and comparison of product fit. Use separate threads, identical instructions apart from source directory, Luna, no external web, bounded read-only queries, no simulation. Prior audit/inspection outputs excluded. Save raw run outputs.

bpi2019: discover-operation completed with Luna in an independent thread, exit code 0. Raw output and extracted final response saved. This was a bounded discovery experiment, not a simulation validation.

BPI discovery output contains an unfinished count, 116,?. Independent parsing of the first 5000 traces found 47938 events. Preserve the original model output and use the reviewed count.

Four datasets differ in suitability. BPI best supports multi-participant process discovery; Amazon supports narrow routing. SCMS and warehouse expose missing information and prompt drift toward analytics. Recommendations are reviewer judgments, not measured rankings.

Skill format validation passed. Four real-data model checks completed. Step 1 now produces provisional process proposals; it is not a validated automatic model-discovery system. No simulator, new dependency, unit tests, or commit added.

Native runtime reports unrelated malformed YAML in three globally discovered Claude skills (attic, decision-timeline, experiment-dashboard) and skips them. Discovery runs still completed. Global skills were not changed.

User selected BPI as the right starting dataset after discussing process mining. Step 1 should map event fields and use established process-mining tools, with the LLM interpreting results. Focus first on BPI 2019; keep simulation and improvement experiments as later stages. No PM4Py implementation has been added in this turn.
Step 1 uses PM4Py process discovery through a native dcode tool, under user-led conversational CLI control. One XES tool, bounded file prefix; no automatic pipeline or new agent loop.
Initial check failed because PM4Py Trace lacks sort; replaced with sorted Trace. Native extension launch required DEEPAGENTS_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL=1; enabled in launcher.

PM4Py discovery on first 5000 BPI cases: 47938 events, 273 distinct edges, 687 variants, 9140 adjacent timestamp ties, 12907 events without resource. Small check passed ordering, elapsed gap, variants, handover, scope and path boundary. Luna called discover_process through native CLI and completed a 100-case explanation.

Native discover-operation skill completed with Luna: called ls, read_file and discover_process; explained the 5000-case process, item categories, variants and handovers, proposed a payment-block waiting question, and stopped before simulation. No shell or write tools called.

BPI 2019 operation discovery: bounded prefix contained 5000 cases and 47938 events, spanning 2001-01-23T22:59:00+00:00 to 2019-04-30T21:59:00+00:00; 687 variants, 273 distinct edges, 241 resources, 9140 adjacent timestamp ties, and 12907 events without resource. Top item categories were 4304 3-way match invoice before GR, 471 3-way match invoice after GR, and 225 consignment. Most frequent variant was Create Purchase Order Item -> Vendor creates invoice -> Record Goods Receipt -> Record Invoice Receipt -> Clear Invoice (1183 cases).

Stage 1 scope: discovery, simulation prerequisites, executable BPI-derived business-process environment, then Three.js inspection/replay. Stage 2 process improvement and agent evaluation deferred. Use PM4Py Inductive Miner, PIX discovery and Prosimos, not a custom simulation engine.

User requested Sol implementation agents and worktrees. Created isolated snapshot repository/worktrees in /data/autotwin-worktrees; product repository history unchanged, no secrets/data in snapshot. Delegate generation and CLI wiring, root reviews/integrates; visualization follows working generation.
Dependency installation failed: No space left on device on root filesystem. Retrying using task-local uv cache/temp under /data with available space.

Product skills now isolated in both agent runtime and explicit skill invocation. Actual Luna explicit-skill check lists only discover-operation and generate-environment; no global Claude-skill parse warnings. Native manual mode was tested: export_view waited for approval, then exported after y.

Removed obsolete archive/intake_pipeline.py. Kept useful read-only intake helpers. Installed PIX0.15.0 and Prosimos2.1.0, pinned tested PM4Py/dcode and Python3.12; old automatic intake is not a product path.

Two discovered modeling/integration issues corrected: missing vendor resource IDs no longer share one capacity-one worker (explicit synthetic external slots); scoped seeded UUIDs plus canonical BPMN export eliminate same-input generation drift. Saved incorrect initial model evidence.

End-to-end native Luna CLI prepared a whole-file reservoir of 1000 BPI2019 invoice-before-GR cases from221010 eligible/251734 source cases, split800train/200heldout before estimation. Final tools build_environment and export_view completed. Prosimos produced200cases/1012events; median completion span962.8149518930555hours vs1609.5583333333334heldout, ratio0.5981858078415231, activity-share total variation0.1452277467438706. Status generated_unvalidated; Stage2 not run.

Final root CLI generation equals independent worktree generation for BPMN, parameters, fitted train data and simulation bytes. Two replay processes match baseline. Source checksum unchanged. Checks passed for heldout isolation, nonnegative durations and resource scheduling. Browser view is offline replay, not a live physical twin.

Packaged self-contained Three.js replay and generated model ZIP under artifacts/. Root browser opened standalone file successfully: 200cases/1012events, canvas present, zero external requests and zero console errors. Final view shows validation mismatch and assumptions. Native Manual export approval exercised and terminal exited. Stage1 complete as a generated, explicitly unvalidated BPI prototype; Stage2 deferred.

Earlier Stage 1 completion described an executable prototype, not a complete BPS validation workflow. Whole-period reservoir selection thins workload; random split disrupts shared-resource context. Legacy bpi2019-demo remains unchanged and unvalidated.

On dev/temporal-validation, expose modeler-controlled partitions and metric/seed choices through CLI tools. LLM selects methodology; code enforces input integrity and reports exclusions. No prescribed split ratios, automatic validity threshold or optimizer. Sol implementation agents use separate temporal-selection and log-validation worktrees.

Replaced reservoir preparation with agent-specified nonoverlapping windows and optional cohort; case cap rejects instead of thinning. Added full-log inventory. Build reads train only and no longer implicitly scores a held-out set. Added official log-distance metrics with explicit seed replications and per-evaluation provenance. Runtime skill keeps scope/metric decisions with LLM; builder discovery methods remain fixed.

Independent review found pandas treating literal NA identifiers as missing. Evidence, fitted and simulation reads now preserve literals; validation selfcheck covers it. Source skill/approval extension now exposes six tools. Product .deepagents/AGENTS.md is tracked rather than lost under generic AGENTS ignore.

Actual Luna CLI independently selected 2-way match and 2018 half-year windows: 220 train cases/968 events and 270 validation cases/1140 events. Excluded 416 crossing cases, 138 outside-window cases and 250690 other-category cases. Built 200 cases/13168 events, evaluated seeds17/29 with100cases each, selected four metrics and exported replay. It identified years-long simulated horizons and reported unvalidated mismatch rather than validity. No test partition created.

Temporal and metric selfchecks, literal-ID regression, compile and JS syntax checks, extension registration, viewer export selfcheck passed. Live-run integrity check confirms partition separation, untouched source and evaluation inputs, baseline200cases, and no test partition. Independent validation worker verified seed42 byte-identical replay and unchanged legacy baseline files.
